visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An Asian man sits in the foreground holding a black microphone, singing with highly exaggerated and dramatic facial expressions, including squinted eyes and a wide-open mouth. He wears a teal t-shirt and camouflage patterned shorts. In the background, an Asian woman in a pink floral dress sits at a white vanity table equipped with a large mirror surrounded by bright, round bulbs. She is busy applying makeup to her face while looking in the mirror. Two small dogs, one brown and one white and fluffy, sit on the carpeted floor near the man. (2) The scene continues as the man sings passionately, gesturing with his free hand to emphasize the lyrics. The woman in the background shifts her focus from her face to her hair, pulling it into a ponytail while looking at her reflection. The lighting is bright and consistent throughout the studio-like room, with clear depth between the foreground singer and the background vanity setup. (3) Several rapid cuts show the man's performance from slightly different angles as he continues to sing the parody song. On-screen text captions appear and change in synchronization with his lyrics. The woman at the vanity appears largely indifferent to the performance, occasionally looking at a handheld mirror or adjusting her dress. The environment remains tidy with makeup products visible on the vanity surface. (4) In the final phase, the man sings with reaching high notes, pointing toward the woman. The woman eventually stands up from her chair as if finishing her routine, but the man turns away and walks out of the frame in a mock-exasperated manner. The woman is left sitting back down at the vanity as the video concludes.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with high-arousal male vocal singing melodically and powerfully, exhibiting professional projection and dramatic pitch variability. The background music is an upbeat pop-rock track featuring a prominent drum beat and distorted electric guitar textures at approximately 128 BPM. The acoustic environment is extremely clean, suggesting a studio recording. (2) A sharp transition occurs as a female voice briefly interjects with a casual, low-arousal statement "one more minute," momentarily ducking the male vocal while the BGM continues its steady driving rhythm. The male vocal resumes immediately with even higher intensity and vocal strain for comedic effect. (3) As the song progresses, another acoustic discontinuity is marked by a second female interjection, "I didn't like them," spoken with a natural, conversational tone. The male singer maintains a high-energy melodic delivery, using frequent rising intonations to simulate mock-despair. The interplay between the polished music and the raw comedic interjections defines the phase. (4) The final phase features a climax in the musical arrangement with more complex harmonic movement. The male vocal sustains several high-pitched notes while a final female vocal reaction, "Don't rush me," is heard. The audio concludes with a sudden hard cut that silences the music and vocals simultaneously as the performance ends.
